   - Implemented [`NewBatchID`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.KOYluYFINQ/repo/internal/core/ops/op.go#L53), [`NewBatchIDWithTime`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.KOYluYFINQ/repo/internal/core/ops/op.go#L58), [`NewEntryID`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.KOYluYFINQ/repo/internal/core/ops/op.go#L63), [`NewEntryIDWithTime`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.KOYluYFINQ/repo/internal/core/ops/op.go#L68), [`NewBatch`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.KOYluYFINQ/repo/internal/core/ops/op.go#L79), and [`NewBatchWithTime`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.KOYluYFINQ/repo/internal/core/ops/op.go#L84) using standard ULIDs (`github.com/oklog/ulid/v2`).
